title_en: Funi Mo's Quest for the Fart
summary_zh: 本页显示‘故事开始’字样，配有一只戴帽子、拿放大镜的卡通鸟，预示故事即将展开。

title_en: Funi Mo's Quest for the Fart
page_text_ocr_zh:
每年春天，牛牛城都会举行“超级放屁王”大赛。
为了夺冠，牛牛们早早就开始憋屁，常常弄得肚子痛。
所以，牛市长宣布，今年的比赛取消，违规放屁者
将被处以重罚！

超级放屁王 比赛
取消！

知道更多
牛是世界上最能放屁的动物之一，每头牛每天通过放屁可产生800升左右的甲烷。可是如果长时间憋屁，屁中的毒素会进入血液，危害健康！
page_text_en:
Every spring, the city of Niuniu holds the 'Super Fart King' competition.
To win, the cows start holding in their farts early, often making themselves sick.
So, Mayor Niu announces that this year's competition is canceled, and anyone caught farting illegally
will be heavily punished!

Super Fart King Competition
Canceled!

Did You Know?
Cows are among the world's biggest farters. Each cow produces about 800 liters of methane daily through farting. But if they hold in their farts for too long, the toxins in the farts can enter the bloodstream and harm their health!
summary_zh: 牛牛城因牛牛们为比赛憋屁导致健康问题，市长宣布取消‘超级放屁王’大赛，并对违规放屁者进行处罚。页面还附有科普知识，说明牛放屁的科学原理及憋屁的危害。

title_en: Funi Mo's Quest for the Fart
page_text_ocr_zh:
牛牛城 警察局
可消息宣布没多久，警察就接到了很多市民的电话。
“我听到一声巨响，接着闻到一股特别难闻的臭气，你们
快来啊！”
毫无疑问，这肯定是哪个牛牛憋不住了，放了一个惊天动
地的大臭屁。
page_text_en:
Niu Niu City Police Station
Soon after the announcement, the police received many calls from citizens.
"I heard a loud bang, then smelled a terrible stench, come quickly!"
Without a doubt, it must be some cow who couldn't hold it in anymore and let out a huge, earth-shattering fart.
summary_zh: 在牛牛城警察局，警察们接到市民报警电话，称听到巨响并闻到难闻臭气，怀疑有牛牛憋不住放了惊天动地的大臭屁。

title_en: Funi Mo's Quest for the Fart
page_text_ocr_zh:
究竟是哪个牛牛竟敢公然违反规定？
警官们请来了福牛摩斯侦探进行调查，他不仅能找到放屁者，
就连放屁前对方吃了什么，都能查得一清二楚。
page_text_en:
Which cow dared to openly break the rules?
The officers called in Detective Fu Niu Mos to investigate. He could not only find the culprit who farted,
but also figure out exactly what the person had eaten before letting it out.
summary_zh: 警官们因牛牛城出现违规放屁事件，邀请福牛摩斯侦探调查，他能查明放屁者及其饮食。右侧插图展示了牛牛体内气体形成和释放的过程。

title_en: Funi Mo's Quest for the Fart
page_text_ocr_zh:
福牛摩斯根据臭味，先是找到了去年的“臭蛋屁”冠军——黄牛。可他发现黄牛早已不吃韭菜、洋葱、大蒜这些食物了。因此，放屁的不是黄牛。

知道更多

屁的臭味与饮食种类有关，一般来说素食者屁味较淡，食荤者屁味较浓。食肉过多且消化不良者，则臭屁熏天。一些有强烈气味的蔬菜也是形成“臭屁”的原因。
page_text_en:
Fu Niu Mosi, following the smell, first found last year's 'stinky egg fart' champion—Yellow Cow. But he discovered that Yellow Cow had already stopped eating leeks, onions, and garlic. Therefore, it wasn't Yellow Cow who farted.

Know More

The smell of farts is related to diet. Generally, vegetarians have less smelly farts, while meat-eaters have stronger-smelling ones. Those who eat too much meat and have poor digestion produce extremely smelly farts. Some strongly scented vegetables are also causes of 'stinky farts'.
summary_zh: 福牛摩斯根据臭味线索调查去年的‘臭蛋屁’冠军黄牛，发现其已不再食用韭菜、洋葱、大蒜等食物，因此排除了黄牛是放屁者。页面右侧的‘知道更多’科普了屁味与饮食的关系。

title_en: Funi Mo's Quest for the Fart
page_text_ocr_zh:
福牛摩斯又根据声音监控，找到去年的“炸雷屁”冠军——水牛。可他今年根本没吃过豆子、红薯、萝卜、板栗这些食物，因此，他的屁量少，声音也小。所以，放屁的也不是水牛。
知道更多
因为豆子、红薯等食物含有大量的低聚糖，这些糖不能被身体吸收。因此，当这些“糖”进入肠道时，细菌就开始对其进行分解并产生大量气体，屁就变多了。
page_text_en:
Fu Niu Mosi, based on sound monitoring, found last year's "Thunder Fart" champion — Water Buffalo. But he hasn't eaten beans, sweet potatoes, carrots, or chestnuts this year, so his flatulence is minimal and quiet. Therefore, the one who farted is not the water buffalo.
Know More
Because foods like beans and sweet potatoes contain large amounts of oligosaccharides, which the body cannot absorb. Therefore, when these "sugars" enter the intestines, bacteria begin to break them down, producing large amounts of gas, and thus, more farts.
summary_zh: 福牛摩斯通过声音监控排查去年的‘炸雷屁’冠军水牛，发现其因未食用产气食物而排除嫌疑。页面右侧科普了豆子、红薯等含低聚糖的食物如何在肠道被细菌分解产生大量气体。

title_en: Funi Mo's Quest for the Fart
page_text_ocr_zh:
接着，福牛摩斯又秘密调查了去年的“面条屁”冠军——红牛。
可调查发现，自从取消比赛后，红牛每天都按时排便，也从
不憋屁。所以，红牛的嫌疑也消除了。
page_text_en:
Next, Detective Fu Niu Mos investigated last year's 'Noodle Fart' champion—Red Cow.
However, the investigation found that since the competition was canceled, Red Cow has been going to the bathroom on time every day and never holds in gas. Therefore, Red Cow's suspicion was also eliminated.
summary_zh: 福牛摩斯调查去年的‘面条屁’冠军红牛，发现其已规律排便且不憋屁，因此排除了红牛的嫌疑。

title_en: Funi Mo's Quest for the Fart
page_text_ocr_zh:
那到底是谁干的呢？
福牛摩斯叼着大烟斗在办公室里走来走去，一遍遍地思考：
响屁的地点——牦牛岗，
响屁的时间——早晨，
响屁的特征——声音大、有烟雾、臭气熏天……
page_text_en:
Who could it possibly be?
Fu Niu Mos, holding his big pipe, paced back and forth in his office, thinking over and over:
The location of the loud fart — Maoniu岗 (Maoniu Post),
The time of the loud fart — morning,
The characteristics of the loud fart — loud sound, smoke, and stench filling the sky...
summary_zh: 福牛摩斯在办公室里思考案件线索，分析响屁发生的地点、时间和特征，试图找出违规放屁的牛牛。

title_en: Funi Mo's Quest for the Fart
page_text_ocr_zh:
他调来了监控录像。奶牛小姐正在打扮自己，大黄牛正津津有味地吃青草，小牛们还在美美地睡觉……一切看上去都很正常。
突然，福牛摩斯指着屏幕，只见画面中的牦牛大黑正张大嘴巴在山坡上哇啦哇啦个不停。
“难道是大黑吞咽了空气，想造屁？”大家都激动地站起来。
知道更多
除了肠道中细菌消化食物产生的气体外，吞咽食物时，如果吞入了大量的空气，也会对屁的形成造成影响，使屁量增多。
page_text_en:
He pulled up the surveillance footage. Miss Cow was getting ready, the big yellow cow was happily eating grass, and the calves were sleeping soundly... everything looked perfectly normal.
Suddenly, Detective Fu Niu Mos pointed at the screen, where the yak Da Hei was seen with his mouth wide open, making loud noises on the hillside.
"Could it be that Da Hei swallowed air and is about to let out a fart?" Everyone jumped up excitedly.
Know More
Besides the gases produced by bacteria digesting food in the intestines, swallowing large amounts of air while eating can also affect gas formation and increase the amount of flatulence.
summary_zh: 福牛摩斯调取监控录像排查嫌疑人，发现牦牛大黑在山坡上大口喘气，众人猜测他可能因吞入大量空气而准备放屁。页面右侧科普了吞咽空气会增加屁量的科学知识。

title_en: Funi Mo's Quest for the Fart
page_text_ocr_zh:
“大黑，臭屁是不是你放的？”大家很快找到了大黑。
“那个屁真不是我放的！”大黑牛连忙解释。
“那你张大嘴巴在做什么？”福牛摩斯追问。
“我……我在练唱歌。”大黑不好意思地说，“因为朋友总说我唱歌难听。”
原来是这样！
page_text_en:
"Dahai, was that stinky fart you who let out?" Everyone quickly found Dahai.
"That fart was definitely not me!" Dahai the yak hurriedly explained.
"Then what were you doing with your mouth wide open?" Detective Fu Niu Mos asked.
"I... I was practicing singing," Dahai said awkwardly, "because my friends always say I sing badly."
So that's how it was!
summary_zh: 福牛摩斯和警官们找到牦牛大黑，询问他是否是放臭屁的嫌疑人。大黑解释自己正在练唱歌，因为朋友说他唱歌难听，众人这才明白他并非放屁者。

title_en: Funi Mo's Quest for the Fart
page_text_ocr_zh:
看来，放屁的另有其人。福牛摩斯询问沿路的居民，继续追查。
“我没看见放屁的是谁，但是我确实看见了屁引发的爆炸。”
“什么？屁还会爆炸？”
“是的，当时我听见耳边风声呼呼！”
“是的，是的，我看见一个草垛被冲上了天！”
“是的，是的，是的，我看见池塘里的水都被炸上了天！”
牛牛城 蛋糕店
Coffee
Flower
知道更多
屁中含有甲烷气体，当这种气体遇到明火、静电时，可能引起爆炸。
page_text_en:
It seems the culprit is someone else. Fu Niu Mos asks the residents along the way and continues his investigation.
"I didn't see who farted, but I did see the explosion caused by the fart."
"What? Farts can explode?"
"Yes, I heard a whooshing sound by my ear!"
"Yes, yes, I saw a haystack blasted into the sky!"
"Yes, yes, yes, I saw water from the pond blown up into the sky!"
Niu Niu City Cake Shop
Coffee
Flower
Learn More
Farts contain methane gas, which can cause an explosion when exposed to open flame or static electricity.
summary_zh: 福牛摩斯在牛牛城蛋糕店外询问居民，收集关于‘爆炸屁’的目击证词，居民们描述了屁引发的爆炸现象，页面右侧科普了屁中甲烷气体遇明火或静电可能爆炸的科学知识。

title_en: Funi Mo's Quest for the Fart
page_text_ocr_zh:
根据这些线索，福牛摩斯在离池塘不远的奶牛花皮家发现了疑点：院子里的大树倒了，房门歪了，玻璃碎了，鱼缸破了……
“不可能是花皮太太！”侦探助理说，“她可是我们牛牛城最守法的牛。”
福牛摩斯说：“在真相没查明之前，谁都有可能。走，我们进去看看。”
page_text_en:
Based on these clues, Fu Niu Mosi discovered suspicious signs at the home of cow Mrs. Huapi, not far from the pond: a large tree had fallen in the yard, the door was crooked, the glass was shattered, and the fish tank was broken...
"It can't be Mrs. Huapi!" the detective assistant said, "She's the most law-abiding cow in Cow City."
Fu Niu Mosi said, "Until the truth is uncovered, anyone is possible. Come on, let's go inside and take a look."
summary_zh: 福牛摩斯根据线索，在奶牛花皮家发现院子被破坏的痕迹，尽管侦探助理认为花皮太太不可能是嫌疑人，但福牛摩斯坚持要调查，决定进入屋内查看。

title_en: Funi Mo's Quest for the Fart
page_text_ocr_zh:
听见声响的花皮太太立刻躲进了衣柜，可却因为太慌张
而将衣角露在了外面。福牛摩斯打开衣柜还没说话，花皮太太就摇着手说：“对不起，我不是故意的。”
“没关系。”福牛摩斯安抚着花皮太太，“请你告诉我们，
到底发生了什么事？”
page_text_en:
Hearing the noise, Mrs. Huapi immediately hid in the wardrobe, but was so flustered that she left a corner of her clothes sticking out. Before Fu Niu Mos could even speak, Mrs. Huapi waved her hands and said, "I'm sorry, I didn't mean to."
"It's okay," Fu Niu Mos comforted Mrs. Huapi, "Please tell us, what exactly happened?"
summary_zh: 福牛摩斯在花皮太太家调查时，发现她因惊慌躲进衣柜，随后主动承认自己并非故意制造声响，并请求解释事情经过。

title_en: Funi Mo's Quest for the Fart
page_text_ocr_zh:
“最近，我的肚子总是咕噜作响，常常绞痛，还放不出屁。我怕别人说我故意憋屁，所以不敢去看医生。当时，我正在门外的山坡上吃草，不小心摔了下来，屁股撞到了院子里的大树上，屁一下子就崩了出来。”花皮太太委屈地说道。
知道更多
肠胃疾病有时会造成不放屁或无屁的现象，如果不及时医治，会影响我们的身体健康。
page_text_en:
"Recently, my stomach has been gurgling, often cramping, and I can't pass gas. I was afraid others would say I was deliberately holding it in, so I didn't dare go to the doctor. At the time, I was grazing on the slope outside, fell down accidentally, and my bottom hit the big tree in the yard, so the gas burst out all at once," said Mrs. Huapi, sounding upset.
Know More
Gastrointestinal diseases can sometimes cause constipation or lack of gas. If not treated promptly, they can affect our physical health.
summary_zh: 花皮太太向福牛摩斯解释，自己因肠胃不适不敢就医，不慎摔倒后屁股撞到树上导致屁突然释放，她为此感到委屈。页面右侧科普了肠胃疾病可能导致不放屁或无屁的现象。

title_en: Funi Mo's Quest for the Fart
page_text_ocr_zh:
终于真相大白了！
福牛摩斯和警官们并没有抓花皮太太，
而是将她送去了医院治疗。
接着，大家联名写信给牛市长，希望把每
年的放屁比赛改为健身比赛。这样，大家都能
健康快乐地生活了！
放屁比赛
健身比赛
page_text_en:
The truth has finally come to light!
Fonu Mos and the officers did not arrest Mrs. Huapi,
but instead took her to the hospital for treatment.
Next, everyone signed a letter to Mayor Niu, hoping to change the annual flatulence competition into a fitness competition. This way, everyone could live healthily and happily!
Flatulence Competition
Fitness Competition
summary_zh: 真相大白后，福牛摩斯和警官们将花皮太太送往医院治疗，大家联名写信给市长，提议将每年的放屁比赛改为健身比赛，以促进健康生活。
